column2: * Student Enrollment: Eligibility (All fee dues shall be cleared) and Credit Eligibility (If any)
Abbreviation:- CIE -Continuous Internal Evaluation; ESE -End semester examination, (S)-Supplementary, (RS) - Regular and Supplementary, CC - Class Committee Meeting, $ After Class Time

In the event of holidays declared by the District Collector or State Government, classes will either be conducted online or rescheduled to Saturdays to ensure timely completion of the syllabus.(#days)
On all designated instructional days, student attendance is mandatory for every event, including arts and sports activities.
Commencement and concluding dates of the ESE are subject to change, if necessitated by prevailing circumstances.
